generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a small, bushy tree with a rounded crown of upswept branches and fine sprays of overlapping scale leaves. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 7 m tall and 25 cm across at breast height at 60 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: grey-green scale leaves; reddish-brown fibrous, shredding bark.
